overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed presentations on the Communities That Care Youth Survey and district elementary literacy initiatives. The committee also approved facility rental rate updates, funding for a replacement hot water heater at Brooks Elementary, an updated staff tobacco policy, and a resolution requesting data on before- and after-school care program waitlists.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills and payroll, capital purchases, grants, field trips, and meeting minutes.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Received updates highlighting Breast Cancer and Dyslexia Awareness Months, student athletic and band achievements, and the McGlynn Elementary playground ribbon-cutting ceremony.

items.title: Communities That Care Youth Survey Presentation
items.summary: Received a presentation on youth survey data regarding student mental health, substance use trends, high school bathroom vape sensor monitoring, and district intervention strategies.

items.title: Elementary Literacy Update
items.summary: Heard an update on the elementary literacy plan, featuring details on teacher science-of-reading training, DIBLS screening data cycles, literacy coaching, and family outreach.

items.title: Medford Public Schools Rate Card Adjustment
items.summary: Approved an increase in building rental rates to $70 per hour to reflect costs from recently settled collective bargaining agreements.

items.title: Brooks Elementary School Hot Water Heater Construction
items.summary: Approved $267,000 for the replacement of the hot water heater at Brooks Elementary School, funded via the city's capital stabilization fund.

items.title: First Reading: Policy GBED Tobacco Use Prohibited by Staff Members
items.summary: Approved on first reading an updated policy prohibiting staff tobacco and vaping product use on school grounds, amended to include nicotine pouches and exclude prescribed nicotine patches, and waived the second reading.

items.title: Resolution on Before and After School Programming Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration provide an updated report detailing before- and after-school care waitlists, transportation, and expansion efforts.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Expressed condolences to the families of Jean Bando, Linda Small, Pasquale Patrick Melchioda, and Rory Douglas-Klein.
